description: Returns a prefilled contact form URL and a mailto link with which the user can send a request to Overfit. Intended for requests where the user wants to contact Overfit, e.g. about a custom AI project, company data packages or feedback. Nothing is sent: the user reviews and opens the link.

summary.description: Brief description of what the user needs (1–3 sentences).

name: prepare_contact_request
title: Anfrage an Overfit vorbereiten
